page.overview:
Who is Margani Altis?

Margani Altis was a female Human who was the wife of Master Djinn Altis. Although the Jedi of the Old Order were forbidden to form bonds, Master Altis secretly took Margani as his wife. She passed away a few years before the start of the Clone Wars. Even during the war between the Republic and the Separatist Alliance, Master Djinn regretted her death and said he would have been a better Jedi with her.
